column2: `render_run_summary_main` builds `token_argv` before display identity resolution and forwards only `args.main_model`. design callers pass `--manifest-path` but not `--main-model`, so `--claude-model` is omitted and main `c_*` tokens price at opus defaults despite correct manifest display.

threading `claude_model` into `display_rates()` alone reprices both `c_*` and `cs_*` buckets. a sonnet main agent would incorrectly reprice aggregate `--claude-sub-*` subprocess tokens at sonnet rates, or underprice opus ci/lint-fix subprocess on an opus-main run. `token_cost_from_args()` must also pass the parsed model through to `_pricing_from_counts()` / `display_rates()` for main-lane math only.

the plan's role-to-model map uses shortened labels (`review`, `scout`, …) but ledger rows use `claude_review`, `claude_vote`, `claude_scout`, `claude_draft`, `claude_ci_fix`, `claude_lint_fix` (from `agents.py`). literal shortened keys miss legacy rows and silently fall back everything to opus.

`--claude-model` is absent from `_flag_names`. any caller injecting it into `token_cost_from_args` or `render_run_summary_main` `token_argv` triggers `valueerror: unknown or incomplete flag` and marks costs n/a before pricing runs.

`display_rates` reads `cache_create_5m` and `cache_create_1h` from the selected claude row. sonnet/haiku/fable rows missing those keys will keyerror or misprice cache tokens when bucketed counts are present.
